system.description:
The Sidereal makes of his caste mark a lantern that can reveal unmanifested spirits. The mark glows with the color associated with his caste and is visible to spirits and to Chosen of his caste. Anyone who can see the light can also see any unmanifested spirits within (Essence x 5) yards on whom the light shines. The light also grants the Sidereal a single automatic success on any Presence, Performance, Occult, Bureaucracy or Socialize roll the player makes when the character deals with gods or elementals. This automatic success stacks with automatic successes from other sources, and does not count as dice gained through Charms.

Scroll of Errata: The Mark shines out to (Essence × 50) yards, not (Essence × 5). Instead of an automatic success on social rolls, it adds one to the Sidereal's effective Appearance rating when she interacts with spirits in any social situation. The light is Obvious only to characters capable of perceiving it.
